description: Update markets reference loader to handle snapshot vs delta Bronze manifests
steps: Investigate current manifest selection logic in markets reference loader
Update loader to prefer the latest snapshot manifest when building the full token lookup
If no snapshot exists for the target date, fall back to latest snapshot + subsequent deltas merged in order
Add snapshot_type awareness to manifest discovery/filtering used by the loader
Unit tests: loader selects snapshot over delta, loader merges snapshot+deltas when needed, loader works with snapshot-only (pre-sprint-11 data)
